title: Kestrel Care Rewards Benefit Notice: Courtesy Limit on Refunded Club Fee Charges (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
Kestrel Care Rewards levels set the courtesy limit on a refunded second Kestrel Rx Savings Club fee charge of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs. The courtesy limit is **6.00 dollars** for a **Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum** member, **4.00 dollars** for a **Kestrel Care Rewards Gold** member, and **3.00 dollars** for any other patient.

The level is read from the patient's Kestrel Care Rewards membership in active status.

| Kestrel Care Rewards level (active membership) | Courtesy limit |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | $6.00 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | $4.00 |
| Any other level, or no active membership | $3.00 |

*Hypothetical:* a courtesy figure of $4.50 is held to $4.00 for a Gold member and to $3.00 for a Silver member, and stays $4.50 for a Platinum member.
